courses.name: B.Sc. in Computer Science
aliases: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
courses.summary: A B.Sc. in Computer Science is a science-faculty bachelor's degree in the theory and practice of computing. The curriculum covers programming, data structures and algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, operating systems, databases, networks and software engineering, with electives in artificial intelligence, data science, cyber security or graphics. It differs from a B.E./B.Tech by placing more weight on mathematics and computing theory and less on engineering design. Programmes last three or four years and lead to software, data and IT roles or to master's study.

courses.name: Master of Commerce
courses.summary: The Master of Commerce is a two-year postgraduate degree in commerce, usually open to graduates who hold a B.Com., BBA or a related business degree. Study builds on undergraduate accounting and finance with advanced financial and management accounting, corporate finance, financial markets and investment analysis, taxation, business research methods and economics, and many programmes offer a specialisation such as finance, accounting or banking. Assessment typically includes a research project or dissertation. Graduates often work in accounting, finance and banking roles, prepare for professional accountancy examinations, or continue to doctoral study and teaching.

faq.question: Which Abdul Hakeem college is this?
faq.answer: This is the arts and science college in Hakeem Nagar, Melvisharam, using cahc.edu.in and its linked admission.hakeemcollege.in portal. The similarly named engineering and technology college is a separate institution; its programmes, approvals and fees are not transferred here.

faq.question: Is this a government-owned college?
faq.answer: The college is managed by the Melvisharam Muslim Educational Society. It has government-aided and unaided programme choices; government funding does not make the institution government-owned. Select the exact funding category when comparing admission and charges.

faq.question: Who can use these admission entries?
faq.answer: These entries cover men through the verified regular domestic route. The currently linked prospectus states that the college is not coeducational. Confirm any later audience-policy change directly; women’s, overseas, transfer and lateral-entry admission routes are not established here.

faq.question: How long are the included degrees?
faq.answer: The own regulations specify ordinary undergraduate study over three years and six semesters, and postgraduate study over two years and four semesters. These entries do not establish an honours extension, shortened exit or research registration period.

faq.question: Which school subjects are needed for UG?
faq.answer: Subject conditions differ. Mathematics applies to Mathematics, Physics and Computer Science; Chemistry applies to Zoology under the DCE group rule. Commerce requires Commerce and Accountancy. Check the exact degree’s conditions and the college’s equivalence and selection requirements.

faq.question: What is needed for postgraduate entry?
faq.answer: The included master’s awards have programme-specific qualifying-degree routes. Some alternatives require an equivalence decision or additional subject papers. Read the exact entry and obtain college acceptance of prior study; a bachelor’s degree alone does not establish entry to every master’s award.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The own undergraduate rules specify English for disciplinary courses, with exceptions for language courses. The postgraduate rules specify English. The B.A. English language-award route is left without a programme-specific medium claim; confirm its arrangements with the department.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Start from the college’s current admission page and follow its linked online application portal. Register, enter academic and category details, and select the exact programme and funding category. Follow college selection, interview and original-document instructions; creating an application does not establish a seat.

faq.question: What do the published fee amounts include?
faq.answer: The official schedule gives first-year first-term combined charges for aided programmes and named term fees for unaided programmes. These references are not an automatically annualised tuition amount. Compare the selected programme, year, section and category, and confirm examinations, accommodation and other costs separately.

faq.question: Why can unaided Commerce have a range?
faq.answer: The current unaided sheet lists different first-year term charges for Commerce sections A and B. The range retains those published section prices; it is not an average or a different-course comparison. Confirm the section and applicable amount before paying.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation included with admission?
faq.answer: Hostel residence has a separate application and allocation process. Ask the Deputy Warden about current eligibility, room availability, deposits, mess arrangements and reporting requirements. An academic offer or historical hostel description does not establish a room.
